MOPD-2026 · Phase 2 · Work 5

Full-benchmark evaluation under five prompt conditions五种提示条件下的全量视觉问答评测

Six public benchmarks, five system-prompt conditions, 160,810 condition-sample records. The report is organised around the evaluation results; the score-source diagnosis is treated as a necessary precondition, and the questions this design can and cannot answer are stated explicitly.

六个公开评测集、五种 system prompt 条件、160,810 条条件—样本记录。 本报告以评测结果为体，评分口径的诊断作为必要前置，并显式记录该设计能够回答与不能回答的问题。

01Research question and design研究问题与设计

How do the five conditions perform across the six benchmarks, and does prompting change answer correctness?五个条件在六个评测集上的表现如何？提示是否改变了答题正确率？

Work 5 applies five system prompts to the same model (OPD-V-Qwen3.5-4B) on the same item set: S0 (no prompt), SC, S1, S2, S3 (progressively stronger output-compression requirements). The six benchmarks are V*, ZoomBench, HRBench-4K, HRBench-8K, MME-RealWorld and MME-RealWorld-CN.
工作5 在同一模型（OPD-V-Qwen3.5-4B）上，对同一批题目施加五种 system prompt：S0（无提示）、SC、S1、S2、S3（逐级加强输出压缩要求）。六个评测集为 vstar、zoombench、hrbench-4k、hrbench-8k、mme-realworld、mme-realworld-cn。
Item项Value值

Conditions条件数5

Pairing配对Same sample_uid present under all five conditions
The analysis population is the frozen per-item paired table; every comparison pairs the same item across conditions.
分析总体为冻结的逐题配对数据；所有比较均为同一题在不同条件下的配对比较。

02Statistical comparison of the three discriminators三种判别器的统计比较

What systematic differences exist between the official native, terminal-line and Qwen-extraction discriminators?官方原生、裁定终行、Qwen 抽取三个判别器，在判定上有什么系统差异？

All three discriminators score the same model outputs. Of the 160,810 records, the official scorer counts 86,090 as correct (53.5%), the terminal-line diagnostic 117,805 (73.3%), and answer extraction 117,949 (73.3%).
三个判别器对同一批模型输出作答。全部 160,810 条中，官方计为正确 86,090 条（53.5%），判定计为正确 117,805 条（73.3%），抽取计为正确 117,949 条（73.3%）。
After correcting for chance: terminal and extraction agree at kappa = 0.926, very high; official agrees with either at only 0.592 / 0.534, moderate. The cross-tables show the structural relation: no record is counted correct by official but wrong by terminal, and only 4 records are counted correct by terminal but wrong by extraction.
扣除偶然一致后：判定与抽取 κ=0.926，高度一致；官方与二者仅 0.592 / 0.534，中等一致。交叉表进一步显示结构性关系——官方判对而判定判错的记录为 0 条；判定判对而抽取判错的仅 4 条。
Discriminator判别器Overall accuracy总体准确率kappa vs official与官方 κkappa vs terminal与判定 κkappa vs extraction与抽取 κ

Conclusion. Terminal and extraction are effectively the same measurement (kappa = 0.926); the official scorer is not the same measurement. The gap ranges from 0.5 pp to 59.1 pp across benchmarks, which shows that it measures output format, not answer correctness.
结论。判定与抽取几乎是同一测量（κ=0.926）；官方与它们不是同一测量。差异量随评测集从 0.5pp 变化到 59.1pp，说明它测的是输出格式而非答题正确性。

03Measurement validity测量有效性

Can the official score be read directly as accuracy?官方分数能否直接解释为准确率？

Vision-OPD's original rule counts a record correct only when the raw judge field, after trimming, is exactly Yes. Of the 160,810 records, 74,720 (46.5%) are non-binary 'reasoning + conclusion' text and are counted wrong under that rule; 31,715 of them were in fact correct.
Vision-OPD 原规则要求判官原始字段去除首尾空白后严格等于 Yes 才计为正确。全量 160,810 条中有 74,720 条（46.5%）属于"推理 + 结论"的非二元文本，按该规则一律计错，其中 31,715 条其实判对了。
Identity. Delta official + delta discarded = delta terminal holds exactly on all six benchmarks. Every point the official score gains corresponds to an equal drop in records discarded by the format rule. This is an arithmetic identity, not a statistical estimate.
恒等式。Δ官方 + Δ丢弃 = Δ判定在六个评测集上逐条精确成立。官方的每一次"提升"，都等量对应被格式规则丢弃条数的下降。这是算术恒等式，不是统计估计。
The ZoomBench official score is void. All 845 of its records have non-binary judge output under every condition, so the official score is identically 0.00%, while the terminal diagnostic gives 57.9%-61.2%. All later analyses use terminal/extraction as the primary score sources.
zoombench 官方分数作废。其 845 条记录在全部条件下判官输出均为非二元，官方恒为 0.00%，而终行诊断给出 57.9%–61.2%。后续一律以判定/抽取为主口径。

05Condition effects条件效应

Do SC, S1, S2 and S3 have a real effect relative to S0? How large, and in which direction?SC/S1/S2/S3 相对 S0 是否有真实效应？多大？方向？

Condition条件Terminal delta判定 Δ95% CIExtraction delta抽取 Δ95% CI

Flip structure (S0 to S3, terminal): wrong to correct 1,463 (4.55%), correct to wrong 2,285 (7.10%), unchanged 28,414 (88.35%). Net change: 822 records.
翻转结构（S0→S3，判定口径）：由错变对 1,463（4.55%）、由对变错 2,285（7.10%）、不变 28,414（88.35%）。净变化 −822 条。
Equivalence test (TOST). The difference is -2.56 pp, 90% CI [-2.87, -2.24]. At any margin of +/-0.5, +/-1 or +/-2 pp the test cannot declare equivalence: this is a real negative effect, not a failure to detect one.
等价性检验（TOST）。差 −2.56pp，90% CI [−2.87, −2.24]。在 ±0.5、±1、±2 pp 任何裕度下都不能判定等价——这是一个真实存在的负效应，不是"测不出来"。

06Stratification and interaction分层与交互

Does the effect vary by benchmark, category or language?效应是否随评测集、类别、语言变化？

The effect is negative in all six benchmarks under the terminal score (-1.0 to -3.9 pp), but its magnitude is heterogeneous (I² = 58.9%). The condition-by-benchmark trend lines are nearly parallel (Figure 10), with no visible crossover interaction.
六个评测集的效应方向一致为负（判定口径 −1.0 ~ −3.9pp），但幅度存在异质性（I²=58.9%）。条件 × 评测集的趋势线近乎平行（图10），未见明显的交叉交互。

07Output length输出长度

How much do the prompts shorten the output, and how is length related to correctness?提示把输出压短了多少？长度与正确性是什么关系？

Condition条件Mean tokens均值 tokenMedian中位数P95Relative to S0相对 S0
S0336.992——
SC369.487—+9.6%
S1306.160—−9.1%
S2331.461—−1.6%
S3260.353—−22.7%
S3 is 22.7% shorter than S0 on average, and the median falls from 92 to 53 tokens.
S3 相对 S0 平均缩短 22.7%，中位数从 92 降到 53。
Mechanism correction. An earlier report proposed that shorter outputs make the judge more likely to emit a bare Yes, which would explain the rise in the official score. The data do not support this (correlation between length and the non-binary rate is only r = -0.155). The real mechanism is that the judge reasons only on hard or contested items, so the non-binary rate is strongly negatively correlated with accuracy (r = -0.917). Length is a by-product.
机制修正。先前报告曾提出"输出变短使判官更易输出裸 Yes"作为官方分数上升的机制。数据不支持该解释（长度与非二元率相关仅 r=−0.155）。真实机制是判官在难判定或存在争议的题目上才展开推理，故非二元率与正确率强负相关（r=−0.917）。长度只是伴生现象。

11Effective sample size有效样本量

Are the 32,162 samples really independent units, and are the intervals too narrow?32,162 个样本真的是独立单位吗？区间是否被低估？

Item项Value值
Items under S0S0 条件下的题目数32,162
Distinct cluster_uid values不同 cluster_uid 数32,162
Largest cluster size最大簇大小1
Cluster-size distribution簇大小分布All equal to 1
Finding. Every cluster_uid in the data contains exactly one item, so the "image-cluster bootstrap" described in v4 degenerates to a per-item bootstrap; image-level correlation is not controlled. If the original benchmarks contain multiple questions per image (common in MME-RealWorld), the current intervals may be too narrow. This must be checked against the original image IDs.
发现。数据中的 cluster_uid 每簇恰好一道题，因此 v4 所称的"图像聚类 Bootstrap"实际退化为逐题 Bootstrap，图像层面的相关性未被控制。若原始 benchmark 存在同图多题（MME-RealWorld 常见），当前区间可能偏窄。此项需用原始图像 ID 核实。

12Design limitations设计限制

What can this design answer, and what can it not?这个设计能回答什么，不能回答什么？

Unanswerable: whether the prompt effect depends on item difficulty无法回答：提示效应是否随题目难度变化

This question needs a difficulty measure that is independent of the treatment, and this design has no repeated measurement of the same item under the same condition. Any difficulty split can only be inferred from performance under some condition and is therefore confounded. Both directions were tried and both failed:
该问题需要一个与治疗无关的难度度量，而本设计没有对同一题、同一条件的重复测量，任何难度划分都只能从某个条件的表现反推，因而必然被污染。两个方向的尝试均失败：
Stratifier分层依据Bias mechanism偏差机制Result结果
Correct under S0?按 S0 是否答对Shares a term with one side of the comparison, so regression to the mean与比较的一端同源 → 回归均值In the S0-wrong group S3 rises from 0% to 17.9%, which looks like 'prompting rescues hard items' but is an artefact
All correct under S1+S2?按 S1+S2 是否全对92% per-item agreement with S3, so S3 outcomes are indirectly selected与 S3 逐题一致率 92% → 间接选中 S3 的结果Easy group: S3 overtakes S0 by 0.5 pp, which is equally not 'prompting leaves easy items unharmed'
Define difficulty by SC+S1, compare S2 vs S3用 SC+S1 定义难度后比 S2 vs S3Two treatments from the same family compared, so circular两个同族治疗互比 → 循环论证-1.2 / +0.8 pp, uninformative
The report therefore makes no directional claim about a difficulty gradient. Both routes push S3 in the favourable direction, which itself shows that the design cannot estimate this effect cleanly. Answering it would require repeated sampling of the same item under the same condition (to estimate noise) or difficulty labels independent of the prompts.
因此本报告不给出任何"难度梯度"的方向性结论。两条路径都把 S3 往好看的方向推，本身就说明该设计无法干净地估计这一效应。若要回答，需要同题同条件的重复采样（估计噪声）或与提示无关的难度标注。

Other limitations其他限制

  • The terminal diagnostic is not a gold standard: it is another parse of the same judge output and shares its origin with the audited object; its kappa of 0.926 against independent extraction is corroboration, not independent validation.
  • Answer extraction is not independent validation either: it is produced by Qwen3.8-27B, the same weights used for the image-assisted audit (report 2225).
  • The human semantic review was not yet complete at the time of the main analysis: material for 60 cases x 5 conditions (300 views) was prepared, but no decisions had been committed.
  • Correlation is not causation.
  • 终行诊断不是金标准：它是对判官输出的另一种解析，与被审计对象同源；其与独立抽取 κ=0.926 提供旁证，但不构成独立验证。
  • 答案抽取亦非独立验证：由 Qwen3.8-27B 完成，与图像辅助审计（报告 2225）使用同一权重。
  • 人工语义审阅尚未完成：60 例 × 5 条件（300 视图）的离线审阅材料已备齐，但无任何已提交的决策。
  • 相关性不等于因果。

13Discussion and conclusions讨论与结论

What do these results mean for the research question?这些结果对研究问题意味着什么？

Reportable. (1) Full generation and both discrimination chains passed their gates. (2) The three score sources are not the same measurement and form a strict nesting (official is a subset of terminal, terminal a subset of extraction). (3) Under the metrics that do not depend on output format, increasing prompt strength did not improve answer correctness; all four conditions are slightly below S0 (-0.5 to -2.6 pp), and this is a real negative effect (TOST does not support equivalence). (4) The decline is larger on the Chinese benchmark. (5) Prompting changed neither the option distribution nor the shape of failure.
可以报告。① 全量生成与两条判别链的门禁均通过；② 三条评分来源并非同一测量，构成严格嵌套（官方 ⊂ 判定 ⊂ 抽取）；③ 按不依赖输出格式的口径，提示强度的增加未提升答题正确率，四个条件相对 S0 均为小幅下降（−0.5 ~ −2.6pp），且为真实负效应（TOST 不支持等价）；④ 该下降在中文评测集上更明显；⑤ 提示未改变选项分布，也未改变失败形态。
Not reportable. (1) Any statement that prompting improves accuracy: the rise in the official score is shown to be a format artefact. (2) Any conclusion about a prompt-by-difficulty interaction: the design cannot answer it. (3) Extrapolating the 60-case targeted sample to the population accuracy of any benchmark.
不可报告。① 任何"提示提升准确率"的表述——官方口径的上升已证明为格式产物；② 任何"提示与难度交互"的结论——该设计无法回答；③ 将 60 例定向抽样外推为评测集总体准确率。

Relation to prior work与既有工作的关系

Vision-OPD scores a record by asking whether the raw judge field is exactly Yes. This analysis shows that, on the Work 5 data, that rule introduces systematic under-counting that depends on both the condition and the category. Reusing it directly would make a change in format compliance look like a change in accuracy.
Vision-OPD 的原有评测口径以"判官原始字段是否严格等于 Yes"计分。本分析表明该口径在工作5 的数据上引入了与条件相关、与类别相关的系统性少计，直接沿用会把格式合规率的变化误读为准确率的变化。

Next steps下一步

  1. Complete the 60-case human semantic review and obtain human adjudication of the disagreements between the three chains.
  2. Verify the cluster structure with the original image IDs and, if necessary, recompute intervals with images as clusters.
  3. To answer the difficulty question, design a repeated-sampling study on the same items.
  1. 完成 60 例人工语义审阅，对三条链的分歧给出人工裁决；
  2. 用原始图像 ID 核实聚类结构，必要时以图像为簇重算区间；
  3. 若需回答难度问题，设计同题重复采样。

Evidence boundary证据边界
Everything below is reference-tier evidence (T2): it comes from one human semantic review. The reviewer's competence has not been formally assessed, the sample is risk-targeted rather than random, and the review page displayed the automatic scores alongside the material.
No number or conclusion in this part may flow back into, alter or weaken any conclusion in sections 1-13 above. The main analysis rests only on frozen data and automated tests (T1). This part is a cross-reference, not confirmation. 以下为参考级证据（T2）：来自一次人工语义审阅。审阅者的判断水平未经正式评估，抽样为风险定向而非随机，且审阅页面同时展示了自动评分。
本部分的任何数字与结论，均不得回流、修改或削弱上方第 1–13 节的任何结论。主分析仅依据冻结数据与自动化检验（T1）。本部分的作用是交叉参考，不是确认。
T2 · REFERENCE ONLY · NOT CONFIRMATORY

14Reference: human review against the three discriminators参考：人工审阅与三条判别器的对照

[Reference] How closely does human judgement agree with the three automatic score sources, and where do they diverge?[参考] 人工判断与三条自动口径的一致程度如何？分歧集中在哪？

What this audit is这次审计是什么

All three score sources in the main analysis are automatic. At several records they disagree, and no fourth source says which of them is wrong. The human review introduces exactly that external view.
主分析的三条评分来源都是自动化的。它们在若干处给出不同结论，但没有第四条信息源说明哪一条错了。人工审阅就是引入这样一个外部视角。
Item项Content内容
Material材料Offline self-contained review page: original image, question and options, reference answer, raw model responses under all five conditions, the three automatic scores with their evidence离线自包含审阅页：原始图像、题目选项、参考答案、五条件模型原始回答、三种自动评分及证据

Sampling design抽样方式Risk-targeted, not random: official/extraction disagreements, official/terminal disagreements, ambiguous or no-answer cases and the longest outputs per benchmark were prioritised; an "all three agree" control stratum was added风险定向，非随机：优先纳入官方/抽取分歧、官方/终行分歧、歧义或无答案、以及各集最长输出，另设"三项一致"对照层

Key design. The "any negative judgement needs a note" rule from step 4 was narrowed after step 7: only extraction faithfulness and judge validity require notes. semantic_correct = no is treated as a directly observable fact (the answer does not match the reference) and no longer requires a note per case. The amendment is on record.
关键设计：第 4 步的"任一否定须附说明"规则在第 7 步后被收窄——仅抽取忠实度与裁判有效性强制要求说明，semantic_correct = 否 视为可直接观察的事实（答案与参考答案不符），不再逐条要求说明。该修订已记录在案。
The auditor's reading procedure: read the raw model output, decide the final option independently, then compare with the extraction; if they agree, mark 'extraction faithful = yes'. Independent judgement first, comparison second, so the agreement rate reflects the actual accuracy of the extraction chain rather than a copy of the score shown on the page.
审计员的判读流程：阅读模型原始输出 → 自行判断其最终结论选项 → 与抽取结果比对 → 一致则记"抽取忠实 = 是"。先独立判断、再比对，因此一致率反映抽取链的实际准确度，而不是照抄页面上的评分。
Of the 300 views, 284 support a binary semantic judgement; 16 are marked "unclear", all with an image-quality note ("the original is illegible", "very dark" and similar), and are excluded from the agreement calculation.
300 个视图中，284 个的"语义是否正确"可二分类；16 个判为"不确定"，均附有图像质量说明（"原图看不清楚""天色黑很"等），不进入一致率计算。

[Reference] Central agreement. In all 72 official-extraction disagreements (62 + 10), the human semantic judgement sides with extraction every time, without exception. This is consistent with the direction of section 3: the official scorer systematically under-counts.
[参考] 核心一致。在官方与抽取全部分歧的 72 处（62 + 10），人工的语义判断每一处都与抽取一致，无例外。这与主分析第 3 节的结论方向一致：官方口径存在系统性少计。

The official scorer is clearly below the human in all five conditions; terminal and extraction essentially coincide with the human.
官方在全部五个条件下均明显低于人工；判定与抽取与人工基本重合。

Direction of disagreement分歧方向

The official scorer is judged by the human to have missed 62 correct answers, with only 10 in the opposite direction - a 6:1 gap. This is consistent with under-counting by the format rule rather than random error.
官方被人工判为"漏判为错"的有 62 例，反方向仅 10 例——差距 6:1，与"格式规则少计"的方向一致，而非随机误差。

Condition effect observed by the human reviewer人工观察到的条件效应

Pairing the human semantic judgements from S0 to S3: n = 57, 4 improved and 3 worsened, delta = +1.8 pp, McNemar p = 1. No accuracy change from prompting was observed - not inconsistent with the "no robust improvement" conclusion of section 5, though the sample is very small and risk-targeted, so it cannot independently support that conclusion.
按人工语义判断做 S0→S3 配对：n=57，改善 4、恶化 3，Δ=+1.8 pp，McNemar p=1。未观察到提示带来的准确率变化——与主分析第 5 节"无稳健提升"的结论不矛盾（但样本量极小，且为定向抽样，不足以独立支持该结论）。

Anomalies flagged by the auditor审计员标记的异常

Judge rationale or label judged invalid or not assessable: 13 cases. Extraction faithfulness judged no or unclear: 3 cases. Several views of Case 46 and Case 55 involve model outputs that looped extensively, ran to tens of thousands of tokens and were truncated without a final answer; the reviewer marked judge validity "not assessable" with a note.
裁判理由/标签被判为无效或无法评估：13 例；抽取忠实度被判为否或不确定：3 例。其中 Case 46 与 Case 55 的若干视图涉及模型输出大量循环重复、上万 token 后截断、未给出最终答案，审阅者将其裁判有效性标为"无法评估"并附说明。

In depth: five questions raised by the audit and their answers深入分析：审计提出的五个问题与结论

Question问题Answer结论
Are extraction errors concentrated in table tasks?抽取错误是否集中于表格任务No. Three audited cases happen to be in HRBench, but of all 4,860 "terminal correct / extraction wrong" records, 88% are in MME-RealWorld (3.62% of that benchmark); HRBench accounts for only 2.0%.否。审计中 3 例恰在 hrbench，但全量"判定对/抽取错"的 4,860 例中 88% 在 mme-realworld（3.62%），hrbench 仅占 2.0%。
Do judge and extraction failures share the same origin?裁判与抽取失败是否同源Yes. 98.2% of the disagreements are "extraction reads an explicit option that does not match the reference, while the judge still says Yes": systematic judge over-counting.是。分歧中 98.2% 属于"抽取读出明确选项、与标准答案不符，而裁判仍判 Yes"——裁判系统性过度判对。
Are the "unclear" cases objectively unjudgeable?判"不确定"的案例是否客观不可判Partly. The 16 "unclear" views concentrate in 4 cases: one image with luminance 17/255 (objectively very dark), two 36-39 MP images (the review preview necessarily loses detail), and one normal image where the judgement is subjective.部分成立。16 个"不确定"集中在 4 例：1 例图像亮度仅 17/255（客观极暗）、2 例为 36–39 MP 超大图（审阅预览必失细节）、1 例图像正常而判断主观。
Is the English MME significantly harder?英文 MME 是否显著更难No. The 24% vs 84% in the audited sample comes from different stratum distributions (the English sample has 10 more hard-stratum cases and 15 fewer control cases). By secondary category, the Chinese version is generally lower or equal.否。审计样本的 24% vs 84% 源于抽样层分布不同（英文样本多 10 例硬层、少 15 例对照层）。按二级类别比较，中文版本普遍更低或持平。
How widespread are image-quality problems?图像质量问题的普遍程度100 images sampled per benchmark: very dark images are about 1%, not systematic; HRBench-8K has a median resolution of 38.8 MP and a maximum of 59 MP, the direct source of its review difficulty.各集抽 100 图：极暗图像约 1%，非系统性问题；hrbench-8k 分辨率中位 38.8 MP、最大 59 MP，是其审阅困难的直接来源。

Two audit-derived findings that can be verified independently两项由审计引出、可独立核验的发现

(1) The S0-to-S3 drop under the terminal score is inflated. The judge over-count rate varies by condition: S0 3.89% to S3 2.30%. Correcting for it gives 70.76% to 69.79% (delta = -0.97 pp), exactly matching answer extraction; the raw terminal score gives 74.65% to 72.09% (delta = -2.56 pp). The direction is unchanged (no improvement), but the effect size should be taken as -0.97 pp.
① 判定口径的 S0→S3 降幅被夸大。裁判的过度判对率随条件变化：S0 3.89% → S3 2.30%。扣除后：70.76% → 69.79%（Δ = −0.97pp），与答案抽取口径完全一致；而原始判定口径给出的是 74.65% → 72.09%（Δ = −2.56pp）。方向不变（无提升），但效应量应以 −0.97pp 为准。
(2) The official rule selects precisely the least reliable subset of judge decisions. Splitting the over-count rate by judge output form: bare Yes is 5.55% (4,776/86,090), non-binary output containing reasoning only 0.26% (84/31,715) - a 21-fold difference. Because the official rule accepts only bare Yes, it does not merely measure format: it systematically selects the subset with the highest misjudgement rate. This gives a deeper mechanism for the "the official score is a format artefact" conclusion of section 3.
② 官方口径恰好筛出了裁判最不可靠的那批判定。按裁判输出形态拆分过度判对率：裸 Yes 为 5.55%（4,776/86,090），含推理的非二元输出 仅 0.26%（84/31,715）——差 21 倍。官方规则只承认裸 Yes，因此它不只是"测格式"，而是系统性地选中了误判率最高的子集。这为第 3 节的"官方是格式产物"提供了更深一层的机制解释。
[Reference] What this part cannot show.
  • It cannot validate the accuracy of the extraction chain: although the agreement rate is 100%, the sample was drawn specifically around such disagreements and is not random.
  • It cannot be extrapolated to the population accuracy of any benchmark.
  • It cannot replace the automated tests of the main analysis, and it does not change any conclusion in sections 1-13.
Its value is this: from a viewpoint independent of the official score, no evidence contrary to the main conclusions was found.
[参考] 本部分不能证明什么。
  • 不能用来验证抽取链的准确率——虽然一致率为 100%，但样本是为此类分歧而定向抽取的，不是随机样本；
  • 不能外推为任何评测集的总体准确率；
  • 不能替代主分析的自动化检验，也不改变第 1–13 节的任何结论。
其价值在于：在一个独立于官方口径的视角下，未发现与主结论相反的证据。

∞Closing remarks结束语

What does this report ultimately establish?这份报告最终确认了什么？

The Work 5 computation chain is fully closed: 160,810 condition-sample records, both automatic discrimination chains passing 30/30 gates, and the v4 statistics with 127 source-hash checks complete. On that basis the report answers, through diagnostic decomposition, why the three score sources disagree, and introduces one human review at the reference tier as an external cross-check.
工作5 的计算链已完整闭环：160,810 条条件—样本记录、两条自动判别链 30/30 通过门禁、v4 统计与 127 项源哈希校验完成。在此基础上，本报告用诊断性分解回答了"三种评分来源为何分歧"，并在参考层面引入了一次人工审阅作为外部对照。
Three statements can be made safely:
可以稳妥地说的是三句话：
  1. The official score cannot be read directly as accuracy. It accepts only bare Yes, and bare Yes has a misjudgement rate 21 times that of outputs containing reasoning; 46.5% of records are counted wrong on format grounds, and many of the correct ones among them are "recovered" under S3, producing the +10.68 pp artefact.
  2. Increasing prompt strength did not improve answer correctness. Both format-independent metrics agree on a negative effect: terminal -2.56 pp, extraction -0.97 pp; after audit correction the cleanest estimate is -0.97 pp. TOST rules out equivalence to no difference.
  3. The unresolved questions matter just as much. The difficulty gradient cannot be answered under this design (no repeated measurement of the same item under the same condition); the image resolution actually reaching the model has not been verified - if the 8K images of HRBench-8K are downsampled in preprocessing, their "high-definition" property is unreachable for the model.
  1. 官方口径不能直接读作准确率。它只承认裸 Yes，而裸 Yes 的误判率是含推理输出的 21 倍；其 46.5% 的记录因格式被计为错误，其中的正确项在 S3 下被大量"找回"，形成了 +10.68pp 的假象。
  2. 提示强度的增加没有提升答题正确率。两条不依赖输出格式的口径一致为负：判定 −2.56pp、抽取 −0.97pp；经审计校正后，最干净的估计是 −0.97pp。TOST 检验排除了"等价于无差异"。
  3. 仍未解决的问题同样重要。难度梯度在该设计下无法回答（无同题同条件重复测量）；模型实际接收的图像分辨率尚未核实——若 hrbench-8k 的 8K 图像在预处理中被降采样，其"高清"属性对模型不可达。
All main conclusions of this report (sections 1-13) rest only on frozen data and automated tests. Section 14 and everything after the evidence boundary are for reference only and do not enter the conclusions.
本报告的所有主结论（第 1–13 节）仅依据冻结数据与自动化检验。第 14 节及此后位于证据边界之下的内容，仅作参考，不参与结论。
